review_candidates.title: Cloud Security Specialist
review_candidates.description: Please note that for this role we are searching for someone who is proficient in the use of the Dutch language (B2 level) and is already living in the Netherlands. De energietransitie is onmogelijk zonder jou als Cloud Security Specialist in het SOC Als onderdeel van het Cyber Resilience Center (CRC) van Alliander, zorg jij ervoor dat de security monitoring op de Alliander Amazon Web Services (AWS) omgeving dik in orde is en blijft. Daarnaast geef jij gevraagd en ongevraagd advies over maatregelen die genomen moeten worden. Ook help jij de rest van het CRC-team om nóg sneller te kunnen reageren bij security-incidenten. Het energienet van de toekomst maken we voor iedereen, mét iedereen. En als AWS Security Specialist werk jij hieraan mee. Zo ben jij bezig met het: optimaliseren van de security monitoring in relatie tot AWS; bouwen en onderhouden van security monitoring use cases op basis van actuele dreigingen en incidenten; adviseren van het AWS-team en de 200 ontwikkelteams over de te nemen maatregelen om nog veiliger te werken; overdragen van kennis naar de eerste lijn zodat zij de meeste meldingen zelfstandig kunnen afhandelen zodat jij alleen met de uitdagende zaken bezig bent; onderhouden van het contact met de Product Owner van het AWS-team waardoor je in staat bent om snel en zelfstandig te handelen. Je werkt hybride, twee keer in de week in Haarlem en eens per maand werk je met het team vanaf de andere locatie (Arnhem). Jij maakt het energienet completer bij Alliander Wist je dat we bij Alliander uit verschillende bedrijven bestaan? Met een grote club vakmensen ontwikkelen en beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners en ondernemers van Nederland. Dit doen we samen en met aandacht voor onze klant. En dankzij onze talenten hebben wij het volste vertrouwen in de energietoekomst van Nederland. Samen met jou maken wij de energietransitie mogelijk. En jij gaat dat doen bij het team Cyber Resilience Center, onderdeel van het bedrijfsonderdeel CISO Office onder de vlag van Alliander. Het CISO Office is het onderdeel dat verantwoordelijk is voor de security van Alliander. Als autonoom orgaan hebben we met alle onderdelen en bedrijven van Alliander te maken. Binnen CISO Office werk je samen met 44 bevlogen experts: securityarchitecten, securityspecialisten en securitymanagers. Als team dragen jullie de verantwoordelijkheid voor het complete informatiebeveiligingsproces van Alliander. De focus ligt op het ontwikkelen van securitybouwblokken, beleid en kaders die het fundament vormen van een veilige digitale omgeving. De cultuur binnen het team is sterk gericht op samenwerking, verbinding en vakinhoudelijke diepgang. We waarderen ieders expertise en stimuleren het delen van kennis, zodat we gezamenlijk tot de beste en meest doordachte securityoplossingen komen. De drive om te ontdekken wat mogelijk is kan alleen als jij genoeg energie hebt. En de juiste werkomgeving geeft jou dat. Het Cyber Resilience Center bestaat uit slimme en betrokken collega’s en heeft een Eerste Lijn (first line of defense, voor het afhandelen van 95% van de meldingen), een Tweede Lijn (waar de specialisten te vinden zijn) een Derde Lijn (voor de senior specialisten) en diverse virtuele teams waarin bepaalde specialisaties zoals Vulnerability Management, Threat Management en Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure met elkaar uitgevoerd worden. Jij maakt het net energieker Tijd vrijmaken voor je eigen ontwikkeling. Dat doe je vanuit je eigen kracht en talent. En dat doe je bij ons. Draag jij daaraan bij met jouw kritische kijk op zaken? En vul je dit daarnaast aan met: Minstens 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met AWS Security zaken zoals Amazon Guardduty en Cloudtrail. Kennis van AWS in een enterprise omgeving Ervaring met security incident analysis en response van cloud-omgevingen. Actuele kennis van de opzet van AWS en bijbehorende architectuur. In jouw meegeleverde motivatiebrief horen we graag naar welke hands-on ervaring je meebrengt op AWS Security operations en jouw ervaring met incident respons op basis van meldingen in CloudTrail en GuardDuty. Voor jou net beter geregeld Daarvoor krijg jij op basis van een 40-urige werkweek: Aan de hand van kennis en ervaring een salaris van €5.416 tot €7.737 bruto per maand (schaal 10); jaarlijks een individueel keuze budget (IKB) van 18% (fulltime) of 12,8% (parttime) van je bruto jaarsalaris. Dit is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag. Je kunt dit bedrag uit laten betalen, maar je kunt er bijvoorbeeld ook extra vrije dagen voor kopen. Jij kiest wat bij jou past; 24,5 vakantiedagen per jaar, aan te vullen met extra dagen die je vanuit je IKB koopt; een eindejaarsuitkering in december van 6% van je jaarsalaris; Elk jaar een DI-budget van € 700,- voor jouw duurzame inzetbaarheid. Kies bijvoorbeeld voor een vergoeding van jouw sport of hobby, verduurzaming en vergroening van je huis, of het verlichten van je studieschuld bij DUO. Jij bepaalt waar jouw budget naartoe gaat. jaarlijkse SANS-trainingen en bijbehorende certificeringen (of soortgelijke) zodat zowel jouw kennis als jouw CV up-to-date is en blijft; werken waar dit voor jou het beste werkt. Je werkt twee (vaste) dagen in de week op kantoor in Haarlem. Eens per maand werk je met het team vanaf de andere locatie in Arnhem. De andere dagen mag je vanuit huis werken. Werk je vanuit huis, dan ontvang je hiervoor een thuiswerktegemoetkoming. Natuurlijk hebben we nog veel meer! Lees meer over Alliander en al jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden. Voor jou net wat meer informatie Samen maken we het net beter. Voor iedereen, met iedereen. En daar hoor jij bij! Solliciteer via de sollicitatiebutton. Er kan al contact opgenomen worden met sollicitanten voordat de sluitingsdatum van de vacature bereikt is. Bij grote hoeveelheden sollicitaties kan de vacature kan eerder offline gehaald worden dan de sluitingstermijn aangeeft. Een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van jouw sollicitatieprocedure. In onze screeningsvoorwaarden vind je meer informatie. Voor deze functie wordt een aanvullende screening uitgevoerd. De Recruiter voorziet je van de nodige informatie. Meer weten over de functie-inhoud? Barry Pouwels, Senior Manager Cyber Resilience Center vertelt je hier meer over via barry.pouwels@alliander.com. Heb je nog vragen over de selectieprocedure of screening? Dan helpt Tim van Beek, Corporate Recruiter jou graag verder via tim.van.beek@alliander.com Voor deze vacature zoeken wij geen ZZP'er of freelancer. A role with visibility across cross-functional teams and the ability to influence product outcomes from discovery through delivery. Through a variety of animal healthcare products, to food safety solutions for dangerous bacteria, allergens, toxins, drug residues and much more, Neogen is there — and you can be too.

review_candidates.title: Talent strategist
review_candidates.description: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Shape our talent strategy. Define and improve how we hire, navigate the trade-offs that determine where effort and investment create the most value, and ensure that hiring remains a competitive advantage for Bending Spoons. Continuously experiment and improve. Challenge assumptions, run rigorous experiments, and use evidence to identify better ways to attract, assess, and hire outstanding people. Own hiring end-to-end. Run the full recruiting loop—from sourcing to final decision—using AI and modern tooling to accelerate the process while applying human judgment where it matters most. Find exceptional talent. Proactively identify and engage top candidates across multiple channels, combining outreach, data, and new technologies to surface the strongest people. Build high-signal evaluations. Design and run structured assessments—tests, interviews, and other evaluation methods—that produce clear signal and support confident hiring decisions. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £56,345 to £85,797 in London and from €54,346 to €82,557 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £196,764 in London or €188,848 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time. Location Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries. The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here. We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times. We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form. Before you apply If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again. Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage. If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Applications of these technologies are in healthcare, NLP, VR, deep learning, autonomous vehicles and countless others. What You Will Be Doing Scoping, designing, and implementing high quality and performance numerical dense linear algebra software on GPUs. Providing technical leadership and feedback to library engineers working with you on projects and sometimes mentor interns. Working closely with product management and other internal and external customers to understand feature and performance requirements and help define the technical roadmaps of libraries. Finding opportunities to improve library performance and reduce code maintenance overhead through re-architecting. Great teamwork, communication, and documentation habits. Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd Experience with CUTLASS, or low level programming like assembly for performance optimization is a huge plus. A scripting language, preferably Python. Experience with working in a globally-distributed team. review_candidates.title: Process Automation Specialist (m/f/d)
review_candidates.description: At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. Flix is reshaping how customers get help, moving towards AI-driven resolution across every channel, language, and market. As a Process Automation Specialist (m/f/d) , you turn that ambition into running systems: you design and deliver end-to-end automated processes on the Celonis platform that resolve real customer cases without human intervention, for millions of passengers. You bring engineering rigour into a business team. You translate business requirements into data models, pipelines, and automations fast, you own what you ship in production, and you are comfortable being the most technical person in the room. About The Role Data integration and modelling: identify the source-system tables and fields that need to be brought into Celonis; build and maintain the extractions, transformations (ETL) and Celonis data models for each Customer Service process, spanning ticketing, order management, and payment/refund data. Automation development: design, build, and operate production automations on the Celonis platform (Action Flows and Process Orchestrator) that execute real customer outcomes (e.g. end-to-end refund handling), including API calls into Flix backend systems and integrations with AI-driven customer contact channels (chatbot, voicebot). Reliability and guardrails: your automations move real money; build for scalability, error handling, monitoring, auditability, and safe rollout of changes. Insourcing and takeover: take over data models and automation logic built by an external implementation partner (reverse-engineer, document, harden, and extend them as the in-house owner). Collaboration: work daily with business users who own rules and business logic, the Data Analyst who owns dashboards and process mining, and IT engineering who own system integrations, security, and scalability. Documentation: document all technical and data requirements and all ETL and automation work to Centre of Excellence standards, so nothing you build depends on you being in the room. About You Automation platform experience: 3+ years hands-on building production automations on process orchestration or automation platforms; Celonis is a strong plus (Data Integration, PQL, Knowledge Models, Action Flows, Process Orchestrator); strong experience with platforms such as n8n, Camunda, UiPath, Power Automate, or Make is also relevant. We care about proven end-to-end delivery, not certifications. Production ownership at scale: you have owned and shipped solutions handling transactions at scale (1M+ annually) and can talk concretely about what broke and how you fixed it. Data fundamentals: working SQL and data modelling basics; you understand how to identify a correct case ID, control grain in joins, and validate a data model against its sources. Scripting (Python or similar) is a plus but not required (you are comfortable using AI tooling to fill gaps here). Enterprise systems and integration literacy: solid understanding of how core operational systems work — CRM, ticketing, order management, and ERP — including their data structures, process flows, and the business logic they enforce. Equally, you are fluent in how these systems integrate: REST and SOAP APIs, authentication mechanisms, webhooks, rate limits, and data exchange formats (JSON, XML). You can independently read API documentation, navigate integration patterns, and reason about data flow across system boundaries. Hybrid profile: you thrive in a roughly 70/30 technical-business role: you sit inside the business, gather requirements yourself, and can explain and defend technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders. Communication: clear written documentation and communication in English; you leave behind artefacts other people can pick up. Conversational automation experience: hands-on experience connecting automated workflows to chatbot or voicebot platforms is a plus. We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! What We Offer Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career Why Join Flix? At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path. As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work. If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

We’re hiring for a venture building a next-generation blockchain for real-time, large-scale applications. Designed to overcome the speed and cost limitations of traditional blockchain infrastructure, the technology is fast, cost-efficient and fully EVM-compatible, enabling developers, creators and communities to build immersive products with greater ownership and interoperability. The ecosystem includes a first-party DEX, a prediction markets protocol and several upcoming products. About The Role We are looking for a Head of Marketing to turn this technology and product portfolio into adoption, volume and a recognised market position. This is the venture’s most senior marketing role. You will report to the CEO, join the leadership team and own marketing across the Layer 1 and the products built on it. You will build a product-led marketing engine that can repeatedly take technical products to market, acquire users and turn launches into sustained growth. This is a player-coach role. You will set the strategy, build and lead the team, and remain close enough to the work to sharpen positioning, challenge campaigns and lead important launches yourself. What you'll be doing Own the marketing and growth strategy: Set the priorities, targets and operating model across the Layer 1, first-party DEX, prediction markets protocol and future products. Drive product adoption: Build measurable acquisition, activation and retention programmes for traders, developers, partners and the wider Web3 market. Lead positioning and launches: Define the venture’s narrative and create clear positioning and go-to-market plans for each product. Build a high-performing function: Shape the team, establish clear accountability and keep internal and external specialists focused on product and commercial outcomes. What we are looking for You are a product and growth-focused marketing leader who has worked successfully across both Web2 financial products and Web3. You understand the structured, data-led approach to marketing found in fintech or traditional finance. You have also applied that experience within a Web3 environment such as a DeFi, DEX, Layer 1 or Layer 2. Senior marketing leadership experience across both Web2 and Web3 End-to-end ownership of positioning, go-to-market and growth Evidence of increasing users, trading volume, revenue or market share A strong understanding of acquisition, activation and retention Experience leading teams while remaining hands-on The ability to use data to prioritise decisions and measure results If you have built and scaled marketing across both Web2 financial products and Web3, and want to shape how a next-generation blockchain ecosystem goes to market, we’d like to hear from you. It's demanding — but the kind of demanding that teaches you something new every week, in an environment where sustainability isn't a policy, it's just how we live. In a nutshell, we love what we do and it shows! 😀 THE ROLE At ALOHAS we're building an AI-native company . Technology isn't a support function — it's the foundation of how the whole business runs: product, brand, growth, finance and operations. We're hiring our first full-time CTO to own our technology end to end — vision, architecture, the platforms that run the business (Shopify, Odoo, data, AI agents) and the team that builds them. We care far more about how you think, build and lead than about your title. If you've been a Senior Engineering Manager, Engineering Director, or Staff/Principal Engineer at a high-growth product company (marketplace, SaaS, e-commerce) and you're ready to own technology end to end and make it yours — this is for you. It's a high-ownership role : you set the direction and you're accountable for delivery, leading a lean internal team plus our AI Software Crafter and specialized partners. Make the calls on build vs. buy vs. partner, and keep complexity low. Go deep on AI-native. Own the AI agent strategy and orchestration (LLMs, MCP, tool integrations). Turn experiments into production systems that move real business metrics — not demos. Own the platform that runs the business. Shopify (e-commerce, retail, marketplace), the B2B/wholesale stack, and their integration with Odoo ERP, data and logistics — a genuinely omnichannel, event-driven system. Make data a strategic asset. A reliable, centralized data platform (GCP/BigQuery, modern ETL) feeding analytics and decisions across B2C, B2B and Retail. Build and lead the team. WAYS OF WORKING Full-time, hybrid, with regular presence at our office in Barcelona. Close, ongoing collaboration with the CEO, the COO and the AI Software Crafter. review_candidates.title: Business Development Manager
review_candidates.description: About Realiz Realiz is a Luxembourg-based financial technology company operating at the intersection of structured finance and digital assets. We set up and administer securitisation vehicles and bond compartments for SMEs, real estate sponsors and asset owners, and we issue and tokenise those instruments on regulated blockchain infrastructure. Our products are designed for professional and institutional investors: banks, family offices, asset managers and qualified private investors. We work with an established network of banking, custody and infrastructure partners across Europe, and we are building out our regulated distribution capability. The company is small, senior and fast-moving. The role The Business Development Manager is a revenue-generating role with two connected mandates. 1. Origination — filling the pipeline of projects to be securitised. Find, qualify and win issuers who need to raise capital through a securitisation vehicle or bond issuance. Then make the onboarding process fast: keep the deal moving through structuring, documentation, KYC/AML and issuance, and remove the friction that typically stretches these processes out. 2. Distribution — building the investor side. Develop and maintain relationships with professional and institutional investors and distribution partners across Europe, so that the products we structure have a defined route to market. Realiz is currently completing the regulatory framework that will govern its distribution activity; the regulated elements of this mandate will be exercised within that framework once it is in place, and the role is designed to grow into it. In the meantime the focus is on relationship building, market mapping and channel preparation. This is a role for someone who wants to own a number, not administer a process. Key responsibilities **Origination and onboarding** - Build and manage a pipeline of issuer prospects: SMEs, real estate and infrastructure sponsors, fund managers, corporates and asset owners - Qualify opportunities against our structuring capacity, risk appetite and economics - Lead commercial negotiations through to signed mandate - Act as the commercial owner of each deal through onboarding — coordinating with structuring, legal, compliance and operations to compress time-to-issuance - Identify and remove recurring bottlenecks in the onboarding process; contribute to making it repeatable **Investor relationships and distribution** - Map and develop the investor universe relevant to our products: private banks, family offices, asset managers, wealth platforms, professional investors - Build long-term relationships and maintain an accurate, current picture of each counterparty's mandate and appetite - Prepare and maintain the commercial materials and channel infrastructure that support product distribution - Work with management to align product design and pricing with what investors actually want **Market presence and strategy** - Represent Realiz at conferences, industry events and in bilateral meetings across Europe - Track competitors, pricing and market structure in securitisation, private debt and tokenised assets - Contribute to commercial strategy, target markets and product roadmap - Maintain accurate pipeline data in the CRM and report on it regularly Your profile **Essential** - Several years of business development, origination, sales or distribution experience in structured finance, private debt, capital markets, asset management, fund distribution, private banking or a related field - A demonstrable network on the issuer side, the investor side, or both — and the ability to activate it - Working understanding of securitisation vehicles, bond issuance, private placements or fund structures - Experience operating in a regulated financial environment, and comfort working alongside legal and compliance - **Fluent French and English (written and spoken)** - Autonomy: you are able to build your own pipeline and manage your own time without daily direction - review_candidates.title: Blender 3D Animator
review_candidates.description: We are The Future Animations. Our artists animate one of the fastest-growing story universes on YouTube. The work goes out daily, to millions of people, on channels the audience is genuinely obsessed with. We are hiring hard because the demand in front of us is bigger than the team that exists. 🎬 Role Description Full-time, fully remote, anywhere in India. You'll own animation on complete stories. Not a shot, not a task in someone else's file — the animation of a whole video, start to finish, paired with a dedicated lighting artist who renders it and a lead who reviews your work. 📅 A typical week One morning check-in with your production manager. That's the only standing meeting. You animate. Layout, body, expressions, lip sync, camera. Your lead reviews before publish. Notes come back the same day. Your lighting artist takes it from viewport to final render. You work whatever hours suit you. Several of our best artists work at night. We staff leads across time zones so you're never blocked waiting for a review. 🛠️ What we give you so you can actually work Render farm access. Your laptop is not the render machine. Renders don't eat your week. A render assistance team for anyone on a slower system. An asset and environment library — models, rigs, environments, ready to pull. We buy what we don't have. Blender add-ons built in-house for texture, file and character optimisation, lighting presets, and cloth, hair and blink passes. A named lead who reviews your work and unblocks you, not a queue. A 200+ artist Discord where people actually answer. 💰 Compensation and how you grow here: We pay per finished minute, published openly, in three tiers. Your tier is set by the quality of your work and reviewed every month — not by how long you've been here. Tier 3 — ₹4,000 per finished minute At 8–10 minutes a month, that's ₹32,000–₹40,000. You get a lead whose job is to push you to Tier 2. Tier 2 — ₹6,000 per finished minute At 10–12 minutes a month, that's ₹60,000–₹72,000. Your lead keeps working with you toward Tier 1. Tier 1 — ₹8,000 per finished minute At 10–12 minutes a month, that's ₹80,000–₹96,000. Past 12 minutes you're over ₹1,00,000. Tier 1 is where we look first when a 3D Lead position opens. Plus a quality bonus on every video that clears our animation guidelines. Two things worth saying plainly. None of our leads earns less than ₹1,50,000 a month. Several of them joined as artists within the last few months. We promote on quality and output, and we promote fast, because we are growing faster than we can hire. Your output is yours. We do not cap what you can earn. An artist producing twenty finished minutes a month earns roughly three times one producing seven. Both are welcome. Only one of them becomes a lead. Payments are monthly, on invoice, on time. Ask anyone in the community. ✅ Qualifications You need to be strong in Blender at: Layout and scene setup Character animation — body mechanics, facial expression, lip sync Camera animation Asset optimisation, and keeping heavy scenes workable And you need to be someone who: Can own a full video without being chased Takes direction from a lead and turns it around quickly Has taste. Sees the difference between animation that's finished and animation that's good. Nice to have, not required: lighting and rendering. We care about your reel. We do not care about your degree, your city, or how many years you've been doing this. Some of our highest earners had no studio experience before joining. ▶️ The work we make https://youtu.be/YFcFDlAsSO4 https://www.youtube.com/shorts/bvn8ESiF-mI https://www.youtube.com/shorts/o7pxb-qOTao Watch the character work and the camera. That's the bar. 📩 How to apply Fill the form: https://forms.gle/sV4TqydrCdPpum887

En jij gaat dat doen bij het team Cyber Resilience Center, onderdeel van het bedrijfsonderdeel CISO Office onder de vlag van Alliander. Binnen CISO Office werk je samen met 44 bevlogen experts: securityarchitecten, securityspecialisten en securitymanagers. Als team dragen jullie de verantwoordelijkheid voor het complete informatiebeveiligingsproces van Alliander. De focus ligt op het ontwikkelen van securitybouwblokken, beleid en kaders die het fundament vormen van een veilige digitale omgeving. De cultuur binnen het team is sterk gericht op samenwerking, verbinding en vakinhoudelijke diepgang. A collaborative environment where product, engineering, customer-facing, and operational teams work together to solve meaningful problems. Opportunities to strengthen product ownership, Agile delivery, stakeholder management, and software product strategy skills. A role with visibility across cross-functional teams and the ability to influence product outcomes from discovery through delivery. We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong. Job Responsibilities The Regulatory Labeling Manager – Lifecycle Products is responsible for the development, maintenance, and oversight of labeling content for mature pharmaceutical products (product that have no additional development activities ongoing). This role involves authoring and updating labeling documents in response to safety updates, regulatory requirements, and internal assessments. The manager collaborates with internal stakeholders to ensure governance processes are followed and labeling decisions are well-documented in accordance with Vertex’s Labeling Procedures. Key Responsibilities Plan and lead labeling updates driven by safety changes, regulatory commitments, and periodic reviews. Author and revise labeling documents including the Company Core Data Sheets (CCDSs), US Prescribing Information (USPI), EU Summary of Product Characteristics (SmPC), and Rest of World (ROW) labels for lifecycle products. Support labeling governance activities by collaborating with the team lead and GLL/RLL to prepare materials, attend the governance meeting and record accurate minutes in a timely manner to upload in the electronic document management system, and ensure required approvals are obtained. Ensure labeling content complies with applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EMA, ICH) and internal standards. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., Safety, Medical, Legal, Regulatory Strategy) to gather input and align on labeling changes, as needed. Support responses to health authority queries related to labeling content. Partner with document specialists and publishing teams to ensure submission-ready formatting and timely delivery. Attend labeling governance meetings and draft accurate minutes in a timely manner. Upload minutes to the electronic document management system. Required Knowledge/Skills Strong understanding of global labeling regulations and guidance (FDA, EMA, ICH). Proven experience authoring and maintaining labeling content for approved products. A strong command of English language including grammar, spelling, and punctuation and exceptional proofreading and editing skills. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Proficiency in Microsoft Word and document management systems (e.g., Veeva Vault). Experience using Label tracking systems, e.g. Intagras, Veeva Labeling. Ability to communicate and work effectively with labeling stakeholders. Required Experience & Education Level Experience supporting labeling negotiations with health authorities. Knowledge of safety data interpretation and its impact on labeling. Familiarity with structured content authoring tools or XML-based labeling systems. Experience preparing labeling components for eCTD submissions. Typically 2+ years of experience in the biotechnology industry, preferably in Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory Labeling or a related discipline Minimum Bachelor's degree, in a Science or Business-related field We are always excited to connect with great talent. No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. new_matches.description: At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. Flix is reshaping how customers get help, moving towards AI-driven resolution across every channel, language, and market. As a Process Automation Specialist (m/f/d) , you turn that ambition into running systems: you design and deliver end-to-end automated processes on the Celonis platform that resolve real customer cases without human intervention, for millions of passengers. You bring engineering rigour into a business team. You translate business requirements into data models, pipelines, and automations fast, you own what you ship in production, and you are comfortable being the most technical person in the room. About The Role Data integration and modelling: identify the source-system tables and fields that need to be brought into Celonis; build and maintain the extractions, transformations (ETL) and Celonis data models for each Customer Service process, spanning ticketing, order management, and payment/refund data. Automation development: design, build, and operate production automations on the Celonis platform (Action Flows and Process Orchestrator) that execute real customer outcomes (e.g. end-to-end refund handling), including API calls into Flix backend systems and integrations with AI-driven customer contact channels (chatbot, voicebot). Reliability and guardrails: your automations move real money; build for scalability, error handling, monitoring, auditability, and safe rollout of changes. Insourcing and takeover: take over data models and automation logic built by an external implementation partner (reverse-engineer, document, harden, and extend them as the in-house owner). Collaboration: work daily with business users who own rules and business logic, the Data Analyst who owns dashboards and process mining, and IT engineering who own system integrations, security, and scalability. Documentation: document all technical and data requirements and all ETL and automation work to Centre of Excellence standards, so nothing you build depends on you being in the room. About You Automation platform experience: 3+ years hands-on building production automations on process orchestration or automation platforms; Celonis is a strong plus (Data Integration, PQL, Knowledge Models, Action Flows, Process Orchestrator); strong experience with platforms such as n8n, Camunda, UiPath, Power Automate, or Make is also relevant. We care about proven end-to-end delivery, not certifications. Production ownership at scale: you have owned and shipped solutions handling transactions at scale (1M+ annually) and can talk concretely about what broke and how you fixed it. Data fundamentals: working SQL and data modelling basics; you understand how to identify a correct case ID, control grain in joins, and validate a data model against its sources. Scripting (Python or similar) is a plus but not required (you are comfortable using AI tooling to fill gaps here). Enterprise systems and integration literacy: solid understanding of how core operational systems work — CRM, ticketing, order management, and ERP — including their data structures, process flows, and the business logic they enforce. Equally, you are fluent in how these systems integrate: REST and SOAP APIs, authentication mechanisms, webhooks, rate limits, and data exchange formats (JSON, XML). You can independently read API documentation, navigate integration patterns, and reason about data flow across system boundaries. Hybrid profile: you thrive in a roughly 70/30 technical-business role: you sit inside the business, gather requirements yourself, and can explain and defend technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders. Communication: clear written documentation and communication in English; you leave behind artefacts other people can pick up. Conversational automation experience: hands-on experience connecting automated workflows to chatbot or voicebot platforms is a plus. We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. Technology isn't a support function — it's the foundation of how the whole business runs: product, brand, growth, finance and operations. We're hiring our first full-time CTO to own our technology end to end — vision, architecture, the platforms that run the business (Shopify, Odoo, data, AI agents) and the team that builds them. We care far more about how you think, build and lead than about your title. If you've been a Senior Engineering Manager, Engineering Director, or Staff/Principal Engineer at a high-growth product company (marketplace, SaaS, e-commerce) and you're ready to own technology end to end and make it yours — this is for you. It's a high-ownership role : you set the direction and you're accountable for delivery, leading a lean internal team plus our AI Software Crafter and specialized partners. You'll work hand in hand with the CEO and COO (who builds business logic hands-on with AI tools) and keep ALOHAS at the frontier of an AI-native way of operating. Turn experiments into production systems that move real business metrics — not demos. Own the platform that runs the business. Shopify (e-commerce, retail, marketplace), the B2B/wholesale stack, and their integration with Odoo ERP, data and logistics — a genuinely omnichannel, event-driven system. Make data a strategic asset. A reliable, centralized data platform (GCP/BigQuery, modern ETL) feeding analytics and decisions across B2C, B2B and Retail. Build and lead the team. Have real, recent AI/LLM experience — agents, RAG, LLMs in production — not just an interest in it. This is the single most important thing. new_matches.title: Business Development Manager
new_matches.description: About Realiz Realiz is a Luxembourg-based financial technology company operating at the intersection of structured finance and digital assets. We set up and administer securitisation vehicles and bond compartments for SMEs, real estate sponsors and asset owners, and we issue and tokenise those instruments on regulated blockchain infrastructure. Our products are designed for professional and institutional investors: banks, family offices, asset managers and qualified private investors. We work with an established network of banking, custody and infrastructure partners across Europe, and we are building out our regulated distribution capability. The company is small, senior and fast-moving. The role The Business Development Manager is a revenue-generating role with two connected mandates. 1. Origination — filling the pipeline of projects to be securitised. Find, qualify and win issuers who need to raise capital through a securitisation vehicle or bond issuance. Then make the onboarding process fast: keep the deal moving through structuring, documentation, KYC/AML and issuance, and remove the friction that typically stretches these processes out. 2. Distribution — building the investor side. Develop and maintain relationships with professional and institutional investors and distribution partners across Europe, so that the products we structure have a defined route to market. Realiz is currently completing the regulatory framework that will govern its distribution activity; the regulated elements of this mandate will be exercised within that framework once it is in place, and the role is designed to grow into it. In the meantime the focus is on relationship building, market mapping and channel preparation. This is a role for someone who wants to own a number, not administer a process. Key responsibilities **Origination and onboarding** - Build and manage a pipeline of issuer prospects: SMEs, real estate and infrastructure sponsors, fund managers, corporates and asset owners - Qualify opportunities against our structuring capacity, risk appetite and economics - Lead commercial negotiations through to signed mandate - Act as the commercial owner of each deal through onboarding — coordinating with structuring, legal, compliance and operations to compress time-to-issuance - Identify and remove recurring bottlenecks in the onboarding process; contribute to making it repeatable **Investor relationships and distribution** - Map and develop the investor universe relevant to our products: private banks, family offices, asset managers, wealth platforms, professional investors - Build long-term relationships and maintain an accurate, current picture of each counterparty's mandate and appetite - Prepare and maintain the commercial materials and channel infrastructure that support product distribution - Work with management to align product design and pricing with what investors actually want **Market presence and strategy** - Represent Realiz at conferences, industry events and in bilateral meetings across Europe - Track competitors, pricing and market structure in securitisation, private debt and tokenised assets - Contribute to commercial strategy, target markets and product roadmap - Maintain accurate pipeline data in the CRM and report on it regularly Your profile **Essential** - Several years of business development, origination, sales or distribution experience in structured finance, private debt, capital markets, asset management, fund distribution, private banking or a related field - A demonstrable network on the issuer side, the investor side, or both — and the ability to activate it - Working understanding of securitisation vehicles, bond issuance, private placements or fund structures - Experience operating in a regulated financial environment, and comfort working alongside legal and compliance - **Fluent French and English (written and spoken)** - Autonomy: you are able to build your own pipeline and manage your own time without daily direction - Willingness to travel within Europe and to be present in Luxembourg regularly **Advantageous** - **German** (a significant plus given our DACH counterparties and partners) - Familiarity with tokenisation, digital assets, DLT market infrastructure, MiCA or MiFID II frameworks - Existing relationships with Luxembourg, Liechtenstein, Swiss, Austrian or German financial institutions - Experience selling into family offices and professional investors - CRM discipline (HubSpot or equivalent) **Who this role suits** Someone entrepreneurial who is motivated by a compensation package weighted towards performance, who is comfortable being measured on revenue, and who wants to help build a commercial function rather than inherit one. Location Luxembourg, or remote from a major European financial centre (Paris, Frankfurt, Zurich, Geneva, Vienna, London and similar), with regular presence in Luxembourg and travel across Europe. Candidates must have the right to work in their location.

We are hiring hard because the demand in front of us is bigger than the team that exists. 🎬 Role Description Full-time, fully remote, anywhere in India. You'll own animation on complete stories. Not a shot, not a task in someone else's file — the animation of a whole video, start to finish, paired with a dedicated lighting artist who renders it and a lead who reviews your work. 📅 A typical week One morning check-in with your production manager. That's the only standing meeting. You animate. Layout, body, expressions, lip sync, camera. Your lead reviews before publish. Notes come back the same day. Your lighting artist takes it from viewport to final render. You work whatever hours suit you. Several of our best artists work at night. We staff leads across time zones so you're never blocked waiting for a review. 🛠️ What we give you so you can actually work Render farm access. Your laptop is not the render machine. Renders don't eat your week. A render assistance team for anyone on a slower system. An asset and environment library — models, rigs, environments, ready to pull. We buy what we don't have. Blender add-ons built in-house for texture, file and character optimisation, lighting presets, and cloth, hair and blink passes. A named lead who reviews your work and unblocks you, not a queue. A 200+ artist Discord where people actually answer. 💰 Compensation and how you grow here: We pay per finished minute, published openly, in three tiers. Your tier is set by the quality of your work and reviewed every month — not by how long you've been here. Tier 3 — ₹4,000 per finished minute At 8–10 minutes a month, that's ₹32,000–₹40,000. You get a lead whose job is to push you to Tier 2. Tier 2 — ₹6,000 per finished minute At 10–12 minutes a month, that's ₹60,000–₹72,000. Your lead keeps working with you toward Tier 1. Tier 1 — ₹8,000 per finished minute At 10–12 minutes a month, that's ₹80,000–₹96,000. Past 12 minutes you're over ₹1,00,000. Tier 1 is where we look first when a 3D Lead position opens. Plus a quality bonus on every video that clears our animation guidelines. Two things worth saying plainly. None of our leads earns less than ₹1,50,000 a month. Several of them joined as artists within the last few months. We promote on quality and output, and we promote fast, because we are growing faster than we can hire. Your output is yours. We do not cap what you can earn. An artist producing twenty finished minutes a month earns roughly three times one producing seven. Both are welcome. Only one of them becomes a lead. Payments are monthly, on invoice, on time. Ask anyone in the community. ✅ Qualifications You need to be strong in Blender at: Layout and scene setup Character animation — body mechanics, facial expression, lip sync Camera animation Asset optimisation, and keeping heavy scenes workable And you need to be someone who: Can own a full video without being chased Takes direction from a lead and turns it around quickly Has taste. Sees the difference between animation that's finished and animation that's good. Nice to have, not required: lighting and rendering. We care about your reel.
